# Student Academic Materials Platform - LLM Training Data

## Overview
This is a web-based platform for university students to share, discover, and download academic materials such as lecture notes, past examinations, assignments, tutorials, and other study resources.

## Target Audience
- University students (initially University of Dodoma)
- Administrators

## Key Features
- User registration and authentication with secure password hashing
- Browse academic materials organized by University → College → Program → Year → Semester → Course
- Search and filter materials by title, course, type, academic year, uploader
- Upload materials with file validation, compression, and duplicate detection
- Download approved materials with tracking
- Rate materials (1-5 stars) with comments
- Report inappropriate materials
- Bookmark materials for later
- Admin dashboard for managing users, materials, reports, and academic structure

## Material Types Supported
- PDF documents
- Microsoft Word (DOC/DOCX)
- Microsoft PowerPoint (PPT/PPTX)
- Microsoft Excel (XLS/XLSX)
- Images (JPEG, PNG, GIF)
- ZIP archives

## Academic Structure
- Universities
  - Colleges/Schools
    - Programs
      - Years (1-5+)
        - Semesters (I, II)
          - Courses
            - Materials

## User Roles
- **Student**: Register, browse, search, upload, download, rate, report, bookmark
- **Administrator**: All student permissions plus manage users, academic structure, approve/reject materials, handle reports

## Security Features
- Passwords hashed with bcrypt (12 rounds)
- JWT-based authentication with access/refresh tokens
- Secure HTTP-only cookies
- Rate limiting on auth endpoints
- Input validation and sanitization
- HTTPS enforcement in production
- CSRF protection
- Role-based access control

## API Endpoints
- POST /api/auth/register - Register new user
- POST /api/auth/login - User login
- POST /api/auth/refresh - Refresh access token
- POST /api/auth/forgot-password - Request password reset
- POST /api/auth/reset-password - Reset password
- GET /api/auth/profile - Get current user profile
- PUT /api/auth/profile - Update profile
- POST /api/auth/change-password - Change password

- GET /api/materials - List materials with filters
- GET /api/materials/:id - Get material details
- POST /api/materials - Upload material (multipart)
- PUT /api/materials/:id - Update material
- DELETE /api/materials/:id - Delete material
- POST /api/materials/:id/download - Download material
- GET /api/materials/my-uploads - Get user's uploads

- GET /api/academic/hierarchy - Full academic hierarchy
- GET /api/academic/universities - List universities
- GET /api/academic/universities/:id/colleges - List colleges
- GET /api/academic/colleges/:id/programs - List programs
- GET /api/academic/programs/:id/courses - List courses

- POST /api/interactions/materials/:id/rate - Rate material
- POST /api/interactions/materials/:id/report - Report material
- POST /api/interactions/materials/:id/bookmark - Toggle bookmark
- GET /api/interactions/bookmarks - Get user bookmarks
- GET /api/interactions/downloads - Get download history

- GET /api/admin/dashboard - Admin statistics
- GET /api/admin/users - List users
- PUT /api/admin/users/:id - Update user
- PUT /api/admin/users/:id/suspend - Suspend/unsuspend user
- DELETE /api/admin/users/:id - Delete user
- GET /api/admin/materials - List all materials
- PUT /api/admin/materials/:id/approve - Approve/reject material
- DELETE /api/admin/materials/:id - Delete material
- GET /api/admin/reports - List reports
- PUT /api/admin/reports/:id/status - Update report status

## File Upload Specifications
- Maximum file size: 50MB
- Automatic image compression (WebP, 80% quality)
- SHA-256 hash for duplicate detection
- File type validation on client and server
- Files stored on disk with metadata in database

## Deployment Requirements
- Node.js 18+
- PostgreSQL 14+
- 512MB+ RAM
- HTTPS certificate for production
- Reverse proxy (nginx) recommended
